thread:
maria: Heads-up — registry alert flagged two staging images with a libssl CVE. Can we triage? https://internal.registry/alerts/3201
devon: Which repo/tag? service-runtime-base?
maria: Yes — `redwood/runtime-base:2026-03-15`. Clair shows CVE-2026-1234 in libssl. Quick repro: `docker pull ... && syft packages`
priya: I can run a quick scan. Question: do those tags have cosign signatures? If not, we need rollback plan before any prod traffic.
sam: Ran `cosign verify` — both tags return "no signature found". Looks like the automated signer failed after last week's RBAC change.
ash: I removed an IAM binding last Thursday that affected the bake principal; likely root cause. @maria FYI.
maria: Right — that RBAC tweak removed the bake role from the KMS key binding, so cosign couldn't access the signing key.
priya: Options: revert RBAC, add a delegated key, or create temporary service principal for signing. Least blast?
devon: Short term: revert signer RBAC to previous policy for `bake-service` so signing resumes. Medium: fix key-binding and tighten scope. Also quarantine affected tags in registry (deny prod pulls).
sam: @deploy-bot set registry quarantine for `redwood/runtime-base:2026-03-15` (simulating)
deploy-bot: Policy update applied — tag `redwood/runtime-base:2026-03-15` set to quarantined.
maria: Proposed checklist: 1) block prod pulls for affected tags 2) restore RBAC binding: grant `cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to bake principal 3) re-run cosign sign flow and verify 4) push new signed tag + canary 5) enable KMS audit sink for 7d 6) postmortem linking RBAC change to outage
priya: I can do steps 2 & 3 if someone approves the binding change and we enable temporary audit logging.
ash: Approved. Please include an infra-change entry and use `--requester=infra-pr` on the binding update. Also enable the KMS audit sink to BigQuery for 7 days.
devon: Meanwhile, for the CVE itself — is an upstream patch available? If not we hotpatch libssl in the base image and rebuild minimal layers. Use `bazel build //images:runtime-base` and `bake --minify` to keep rebuild fast.
maria: Target: minimal rebuild updating libssl only, keep other layers pinned. Priya, can you produce a signed canary in staging within 3h?
priya: Starting now. I'll update this thread with cosign output and scrubbed `gcloud kms` logs.
sam: Also add fallback routing: pin Dedicated fleet to previous signed tag until we validate the new one.
maria: Action items: priya (signing + push), devon (quarantine + rollback policy), ash (approve RBAC + enable KMS audit sink), sam (fleet pin + monitoring). ETA 3h. Any objections?
ash: No objections. go for it :thumbsup:
priya: Quick update: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ci-sign#1 redwood/runtime-base:2026-03-15` -> error: `permission denied: cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign`. Requesting key permission now.
maria: In parallel, create a temporary limited `keywrap-service-account` that has only the `cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` role and is audited. We'll rotate it after this incident.
devon: Registry quarantine enforcement confirmed — prod pulls now 403 for those tags.
priya: Permission granted by @ash. Retrying sign...
priya: `cosign sign` succeeded. `cosign verify` -> "Verified OK: redwood/runtime-base:2026-03-15-signed"
sam: Rolling a canary to 2 nodes in staging. Monitoring logs/metrics for token errors and start-up failures.
maria: If canary stays green for 15m, promote and update fleets. Also draft a short advisory for customers about the CVE + mitigations.
priya: Pushing final patch tag `redwood/runtime-base:2026-03-15-patched-signed`. `cosign verify` OK. Publishing advisory now.
deploy-bot: Incident resolved — image-signing failure root cause: RBAC change; action: RBAC reverted for bake-role, KMS audit sink enabled, affected tags quarantined then replaced with signed patch.
maria: Closing loop. I'll file the incident ticket and schedule a 30-min retro to adjust RBAC review checklist and add an automated check that verifies signer principal access after infra changes. Thanks all.
